test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a square table facing outwards. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. A is sitting to the immediate left of B and right of H. H is sitting between A and G. F is sitting to the immediate left of G and right of E. D is sitting between E and C. C is sitting to the immediate right of B. Who is sitting between C and E?
solution:
The sitting arrangement here is:

1) A is sitting to the immediate left of B and right of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90a21c70989ad0cdb445ec7e84979db23ba44bd393fa15a3568d6b27822283f5.png] 

2) H is sitting between A and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/605857d677b245d09a064c677a5f4d0fe93a937205f6e5f0742e03e823b70cc0.png] 

3) F is sitting to the immediate left of G and right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a930a7289d6b8b314bb029a4fe67a6336f9eab740856cb9adf6635fa1474b774.png] 

4) D is sitting between E and C. 

5) C is sitting to the immediate right of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00d5c4d3dd931d5b4fc902b4aa14a0de80ba7102f5dd0a2d1d8ea03eb3aceda5.png] 

The people are sitting facing outwards (i.e. **towards the opposite direction of the table**), unlike the normal sitting position. 

Thus, the person sitting between C and E is** D**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"*.***
